clips.title: The story
paras: Sen'jin Village is a coastal settlement on the southern shores of Durotar, serving as a sanctuary for the Darkspear trolls. Established by Chieftain Vol'jin after his people were driven from their ancestral home on the Echo Isles, the hamlet honors his fallen father, the witch doctor Sen'jin. Today, it stands as a fragile haven focused on survival, herbalism, and reclaiming what was stolen.

When the dark witch doctor Zalazane betrayed the Darkspear and seized control of the Echo Isles, Chieftain Vol'jin was forced to lead the survivors across the strait to the mainland of Durotar. There, nestled beneath coastal cliffs and looking out over the water, they raised crude huts and established Sen'jin Village. The settlement carries the name of Vol'jin's father, the venerable elder who was captured and sacrificed by murlocs during the Third War. Despite their close alliance with Thrall's Horde, the trolls here live under the shadow of exile, staring daily across the shallows at the home they lost.

Daily life in Sen'jin Village revolves around preparation and defense. Between local quilboar raids, aggressive sea beasts, and Zalazane's hexes reaching across the sea, the villagers rely heavily on herbal remedies and brewing potent alchemical spirits. While Vol'jin coordinates broader tribal defense from the Horde capital, local shamans, hunters, and scouts gather here to recruit fresh wanderers stepping out of the Valley of Trials. Their aim is clear: to gather resources, protect Durotar's southern flank, and plot the eventual downfall of the traitor Zalazane.
